rows.summary: A language's Proficiency select shows the stored level: a 'Not set' option holds '', and a level the five do not name ('Conversational', 'C1') is listed as its own option and selected, so the editor shows what the résumé prints and every level can be picked in one step. New languages still start at Professional. The supplied patch was reviewed by a second agent (held) and landed as is.

A paste or a drop into a rich-text field is always cancelled and only its text inserted (sanitized), so a copied screenshot or an image file inserts nothing; emit() removes any img/picture/media element before storing; and a field already stored with a base64 data: URL inside a tag is stored again without it when shown (a value without one writes nothing). A paste event with no clipboardData is left to the browser.

Product call: a Custom entry's Date / Period that the month picker cannot hold (an imported 'Jan 2020 – Mar 2021', '2019 – 2021', 'Summer 2020') is a text box showing it as it prints, and stays one while the entry is on screen; picker-shaped and empty dates keep the picker. MonthPicker itself is unchanged.
rows.remaining: Other month pickers (Experience/Education Start/End, Award and Certificate dates) still cut free text they cannot read; importers store single dates there, so low risk.

rows.summary: A drag of selected text inside a rich-text field is moved by the editor: dragstart records the selection and marks the drag with the editor's own id; the drop deletes the source (execCommand 'delete', undoable) and inserts the text sanitized at the drop point. A drop with no mark only inserts, even if an earlier drag lost its dragend; a drag with no selection is not a move. Firefox finds the drop point with caretPositionFromPoint. A drag from one field to another still copies.

Header Bottom Border's Thickness box is typed with useTypedNumber like the other stepper boxes: it can be emptied, holds what is typed, and writes once on Enter or leaving, clamped to 1–12 pt; Escape and click-in-and-out write nothing.

An entry is untouched when every text field is empty or still its new-entry (NEW_ITEM) value and it has no non-empty bullets; such an entry, a fresh Language row at 'Professional' included, is deleted without 'Delete this entry?'.

Product call: a card whose entry is untouched (the R4-ED-06 rule) opens when it mounts, so the entry Add makes and a new section's first entry show their fields at once; entries with content stay collapsed. Two Cypress specs that clicked 'New Entry' open were updated to the new behaviour.
